ETH1.notes: Carries all PLC traffic: IDE, Modbus TCP, MQTT

ETH2.notes: Unplugged; no answer to ping is expected

COM1.connector: RJ12 jack (RS485: pin 3 TXRX+, pin 4 TXRX-, pins 1/6 GND)
COM1.wiredTo: USB-RS485 adapter BG041BD0 (PC COM12) and the Ebyte ME31 (9600 8N1, unit 1), in parallel
COM1.polarity: RJ12 pin 3 (TXRX+) to the adapter TX+ and the ME31 A; pin 4 to TX- and B
COM1.verified: 2026-10-20: transmits and receives. Native Modbus_COM master on ComPort 1 polls the ME31 every ~140 ms, RESPONSE_SUCCESS. Use this port for serial work on the bench.

COM2.wiredTo: Nothing since 2026-10-20 (moved to the RJ12 port)
COM2.polarity: The PLC terminal on the adapter's TX+ is the + line; on an Ebyte device that is A
COM2.verified: FAULTY RECEIVE on this unit (2026-10-20): transmits, never receives (RXD LED dark) with a native master, ModbusFB and raw SysCom, while the identical configuration and devices work on COM1/RJ12. RS485 mode is applied (idle pin 3 +1.08 V, pin 2 +1.18 V). Do not use it for testing.

BG01GGR2.label: Bench RS485 adapter on the NE2-D11P bus (simulated units 1-10)

BG00XX03.label: Bench RS485 adapter on the NA111-E bus (simulated unit 11)

BG041BD0.label: RS485 adapter on the PLC's terminal block (PLC COM2), 9600 8N1
BG041BD0.notes: Simulates the PLC's own serial devices (examples/plc_architecture/bench/bus_sim.py) or listens (bench/sniff_serial.py) when no simulator owns it. TX+ = the + line.
